messages:
anya: Heads-up from sales: Zenith wants model-pinning + canary rollouts enabled for their pilot (starts Jun 7). They said rollback guarantees are a must.
jason: timeline wise that's earlier than our v1 window. we can accelerate, but we need to cut scope elsewhere or accept a later v1.
lucy: engineering estimate: 3 weeks to finish pinning + rollout infra, 1 week for QA. current sprint is full.
mike: options: 1) Scope cut the feature flags dashboard (defer to v1) and reassign two engs to rollout infra, or 2) deliver a guarded "manual pin" flow (no UI) for pilot and finish automated rollout in v1.
anya: Zenith cares about self-service pinning, but they said a manual API driven pin for the pilot is acceptable if we promise automated rollouts in v1.
jason: manual API pin sounds low risk and faster. what are the product tradeoffs? no visibility for product or support into active pins unless we add logging.
lucy: we can add audit logs to the telemetry plane and keep the dashboard deferred. that gives support visibility without building full UI.
sarah-legal: also flag: the pilot contract needs a rollback SLA clause. propose: we commit to a documented rollback procedure and a 4-hour remediation window for critical regressions.
mike: ops can implement an emergency toggle for whole-tenant fallback. runbook + toggle test will take ~2 days.
deploy-bot: notice: feature-branch "pilot/zenith/manual-pin" scheduled deploy on 2026-06-01 03:30 UTC. status: pending.
anya: decision proposal: ship manual API pin + audit logs for pilot; defer flags dashboard and advanced metrics to v1; include rollback SLA + runbook in pilot T&C. approve?
jason: approve. i'll update the product tracker and mark dashboard deferred to v1 milestone.
lucy: approve from eng. i'll add audit logging spec and ETA (6/4).
mike: approve from ops. i'll own the runbook and emergency toggle test (due 6/3).
sarah-legal: approve pending final wording. i'll circulate the rollback clause for sign-off.
anya: thanks. Action items: jason - update tracker & customer note; lucy - audit logging spec; mike - runbook + toggle test; sarah - finalize SLA clause. target: all done by 2026-06-04 so we can onboard Zenith for Jun 7 pilot.
